title: The Battle of Yavin
text: The Battle of Yavin was the climactic battle at the end of the first Star Wars film. The Rebel Alliance launched a desperate assault on the Empire's Death Star, a moon-sized battle station capable of destroying entire planets. Luke Skywalker, flying an X-wing starfighter, used the Force to guide a proton torpedo into a small thermal exhaust port, triggering a chain reaction that destroyed the station and dealt the Empire a devastating blow.

title: The Jedi Order
text: The Jedi Order was an ancient organization of Force-sensitive peacekeepers who served the Galactic Republic for thousands of years. Jedi trained from a young age to master the light side of the Force, valuing discipline, wisdom, and selflessness. The Order was based at the Jedi Temple on Coruscant and was nearly wiped out during Order 66, when clone troopers turned on their Jedi generals under Emperor Palpatine's secret command.

title: The Galactic Empire
text: The Galactic Empire rose from the ashes of the Republic after Chancellor Palpatine declared himself Emperor, ending centuries of democratic rule. The Empire ruled through fear, military might, and the suppression of the Jedi. Its most feared enforcer was Darth Vader, a former Jedi who had turned to the dark side. The Empire was ultimately defeated by the Rebel Alliance after years of galactic civil war.

title: Darth Vader's Fall and Redemption
text: Anakin Skywalker was once a promising Jedi Knight, prophesied to bring balance to the Force. Manipulated by Palpatine and driven by fear of losing loved ones, Anakin turned to the dark side and became Darth Vader, the Emperor's enforcer. Decades later, Vader was redeemed when he turned against the Emperor to save his son, Luke Skywalker, sacrificing his own life in the process.

title: The Rebel Alliance
text: The Rebel Alliance was a coalition of resistance fighters and defected soldiers who opposed the Galactic Empire's tyranny. Led by figures like Princess Leia Organa and Mon Mothma, the Alliance relied on guerrilla tactics, stolen Imperial secrets, and the support of sympathetic worlds. Its greatest victories came from small, decisive strikes, most famously the destruction of two Death Stars.

title: The Force
text: The Force is a mystical energy field that binds the galaxy together, generated by all living things. It has two sides: the light side, associated with peace and knowledge, practiced by the Jedi, and the dark side, associated with anger and power, practiced by the Sith. Force users can perform feats like telekinesis, mind influence, and precognition, with abilities varying based on training and natural sensitivity.

title: Obi-Wan Kenobi's Exile
text: After the fall of the Jedi Order and Anakin's turn to the dark side, Obi-Wan Kenobi went into hiding on the desert planet Tatooine. He took on the identity of a hermit, watching over the infant Luke Skywalker from a distance for nearly two decades. When Luke came of age, Obi-Wan revealed the truth about the Jedi and began training him in the ways of the Force before sacrificing himself in a duel with Vader.

title: The Sith
text: The Sith were an ancient order of Force users devoted to the dark side, believing that power was achieved through passion and conflict rather than peace. For centuries, the Sith operated under the Rule of Two, allowing only a master and an apprentice to exist at once, to avoid the infighting that had once destroyed their order. Darth Sidious, later Emperor Palpatine, and his apprentice Darth Vader were the last Sith of this era.
